competitors.name: UNFI
competitors.action: UNFI's 2026 Holiday and Winter Selling Show drew more than 1,400 grocery retail representatives and 715 suppliers, with almost 70 new-to-market brands. Progressive Grocer reported UNFI's highlighted trend areas as private label for premium holiday entertaining, fresh produce as culinary inspiration, and functional wellness moving into seasonal occasions.

competitors.name: Kroger Precision Marketing / TikTok
competitors.action: Kroger Precision Marketing partnered with TikTok so advertisers can target Kroger shoppers on TikTok using Kroger purchase data through TikTok's self-service ad platform. Grocery Dive reported Kroger's view that social content is increasingly tied to grocery purchase behavior, making social discovery and retail-media readiness more important for freezer and CPG brands.

competitors.name: PepsiCo / Coca-Cola / Keurig Dr Pepper
competitors.action: Major beverage CPGs are adding QR-code links to ingredient information through the American Beverage Association's Good to Know initiative, with broader industry participation targeted by the end of 2027. Food Dive reported the move as a response to rising consumer scrutiny of ingredients and safety, reinforcing transparency as a CPG packaging expectation beyond beverages.
